verdict.rationale: Viam documents its own access-control capability. The fleet management API can 'manage permissions and authorization' across organizations, locations, and machines, pricing lists 'access control' under Fleet Management, and machines can optionally enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions through `user_permissions` in the machine config. The evidence only mentions these features briefly and does not describe named roles that separate command, configure, and view rights for each robot. missing for 10: explicit role definitions (e.g. operator vs. viewer vs. owner), documented per-machine scoping of configure/view rights, in-depth docs on assigning permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
